text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh?
Where is this musica coming from—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah... is that you, Duramente-san?!
Avoiding the crowds to enjoy the music, benissimo!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...This isn't leisure, it's music practice.
I have to give a presentation in class
to 'deepen our understanding of music.'

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Oho, I see. May your unflagging dedication
lead to your own unique melodia!"
(...*creeeak!*)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh...
Once more, from the beginning—
—That's enough, my passionate musicista!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Your fingertips are so red...
And yet, you take up the bow once more to play.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Why to such an extent?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Her comportment, her attitude toward all things.
Because being the "strongest" isn't limited to how one appears in a race.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Just as the members of our clan must be,
every ounce of my being must be worthy of that resolve.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: However—
(...*creak! creeeak!*)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Earnest, straightforward.
A 'sound' so honest it's almost clumsy.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: And—it's the "sound" that burns within my chest.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A performance recital to "deepen our understanding of music."
...Right? If so, we should be free to choose any instrument.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Come, let us head toward a more fantastico melody!
Allow me to guide you to the stage where you can truly shine!

Today is the open-class day.
Duramente's class is supposed to give a musical performance, but—

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Here it is, it's Duramente's turn for the practical test!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
"Rumor has it she loves classical music...
I'm sure she'll play something truly elegant, don't you think?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
“—'Any instrument will do.'
That is what you said, isn't it, Teacher?”

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Yes! Please feel free to play as you like.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Now then, as for my instrument—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
With these legs,
I shall keep the rhythm and perform my dance.

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: D... Dance?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Every Umamusume holds a fantastico "sound" within her!
Just waiting for the moment to play it!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Your greatest strength as an athlete is...
the feel of kicking the turf! The rhythm of your legs!
In other words, your sense of "tempo"!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grow wings on your heart, and beat the rhythm with your legs!
—Charm every single person with your free-spirited dance!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...One, two, three, four. *huff*, *puff*.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
...A-Aaamazing!
Her legs are clack-clacking, so faaast!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
T-To think such an expression existed...!
...Yes, preconceived notions are unnecessary! Music is freedom!
(Clap clap clap clap!)

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san's "performance" was amazing!
—I got so caught up in the rhythm, I couldn't take my eyes off her!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (So this is... my "sound"?)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Not bad.
choice_data_list: You really 'played' the whole piece with your signature stamina!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Who knew the stamina built up through daily training would come in handy like this...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I've truly realized the importance of discipline.
Come, let us begin today's training.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So practicing an instrument counts as muscle training too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Now I owe Earth two favors.
